properties.title: Roseberry Attic Room
properties.description: A brass key to the private attic guest room at Roseberry Inn, hired for the agreed paid stay. Its little tag bears the guest's name and the arrangement made at the desk. The room contains a bed, washstand, locking chest and writing table; the other rooms remain other guests' property.

properties.title: Whitepass Drying-Loft Room
properties.description: A broad iron key to the hired private room above Whitepass Caravan Lodge's drying loft. Akemi Fushida's tag records the lodger and paid stay. It opens a warm room with a sturdy bed, gear hooks and a shuttered mountain window; it is not a key to the lodge's stores or other guests' rooms.
properties.area: Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Whitepass Drying-Loft Room

properties.title: Canopy Guest Bough
properties.description: A small carved key to a private hired guest bough in Asterveil Canopy. A knotted tag records the visitor and agreed stay. The room has an adjustable sleeping nook, a sheltered work shelf and space for ordinary luggage; the surrounding household's private branches remain private.

properties.title: Willowbend Courtyard Cottage
properties.description: The iron front-door key and folded deed to the purchased Willowbend courtyard cottage. The papers name the buyer and describe a small private home with a kitchen, sleeping room, storage loft and narrow garden. It is a modest permanent home, with the responsibilities of maintaining it.
properties.area: Willowbend Residential District - Willowbend Courtyard Cottage

properties.title: Merchant's Row Bench Workshop
properties.description: A square brass key tied to the purchase papers for the small bench workshop on Merchant's Row. The buyer is named beside a plan of the workroom, counter and lockable materials cupboard. The building supplies ordinary workspace; specialized tools, rare materials and customers must be acquired separately.
properties.area: Merchant's Row - Merchant's Row Bench Workshop

properties.title: Snowmelt Landing Flat
properties.description: A heavy iron key and purchase deed for a compact flat off Snowmelt Residential Steps. The papers name its buyer. Inside are a sleeping alcove, a tiny hearth kitchen, a work table and a sheltered gear cupboard. Ownership of this flat grants no clan membership or authority over the shared stair.
properties.area: Snowmelt Residential Steps - Snowmelt Landing Flat

opportunities.text: Ranka Kagari is trying to arrange a small recovery-formula trial; somebody at the faculty table is asking why two dosage sheets disagree.
Two students compare reassessment notices with different requirements for what appears to be the same exercise.
A student complains that a loaned shield has not come back to Mai Kajiwara's repair queue.
People near Kaoruko Hanazono's workroom are arguing about a fragrance batch that changed after leaving the bench.
A customer asks Rui Takatori why a purchased light does not behave like the demonstration.
At the cargo pier, a delivery is waiting because nobody has matched it to an actual accepting party.
Growers downstream are comparing the water reaching their irrigation runs with what their neighbors expected.
Two traders are checking the same weight on different scales, drawing a small but interested audience.
A reader has noticed two different hands making incompatible notes in a much-consulted text.
A practice entrant has been told to arrive early, and is trying to find out which part of the preparation actually matters.
A tired performer at Snowbell Playhouse is comparing the advertised opening date with the rehearsal everyone actually attended.
A previous bout is still being argued about at the booking desk, and somebody wants a properly arranged rematch.
Neighbors are measuring a shared landing and disagreeing about whether another bench would help or block the way.
A herder has marked unfamiliar tracks near the winter fold and wants a sound explanation before moving the animals.
A celebration rehearsal and the first flowering work both need the same stretch of shared Canopy space.
Expeditioners compare a shed comb fragment with the immense filter feeders seen riding the mountain's lee currents.
A conservatory worker is examining a damaged pollen screen while two colleagues disagree about how it happened.
An authorized records visitor asks why two dates in the same case file do not agree. This is public counter business, not access to the secure archive.

Daigo Kisaragi's Bellwether Company has returned with frost samples and no confident reading of them. They need help tracing the unnatural cold from Coldglass Galleries; their martial experience has stopped being enough.

Suzuha Midorise is looking for help finding the Stillwind Pearl after her guild posting attracted no volunteers. She has measurements, stubborn hope and very little ability to defend herself in the wild.
An expeditioner is complaining that the Copper Laurels demanded a recovery fee for a prize they never helped recover. Another traveler has heard the same boast at a different crossing.
